import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd()
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6,5))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,10); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.plot([1,1,8,8,1],[2,9,9,2,2],lw=3)
ax.plot([1,8],[9.3,9.3],lw=6); ax.text(4.5,9.5,'PU roof 100mm')
ax.text(0.0,5.5,'PU wall',rotation=90); ax.text(8.1,5.5,'PU wall',rotation=90)
ax.plot([3,3.2,6.8,7],[4,3.4,3.4,4],lw=2); ax.text(4,2.7,'slatted floor')
for x,y in [(3,4.5),(4.5,4.5),(6,4.5),(3,6),(4.5,6),(6,6)]:
  ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x,y),1.1,1.0,fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(x+0.2,y+0.4,'crate',fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((2,7.5),2,1.0,fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(2.2,7.8,'evaporator+fan')
ax.arrow(4,7.5,2.5,-1.2,lw=1.5); ax.arrow(6,7.5,-2.5,-1.2,lw=1.5)
ax.text(1.2,2.2,'door seal'); ax.plot([7,8],[2.5,2.5],lw=4)
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((8.4,5),1.2,1.5,fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(8.4,6.8,'condenser',fontsize=8)
ax.text(3,0.8,'cold box 2x2x2.2m inside, airflow loop')
plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=120); print('saved')
